coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): all three required prompting methods and all three tasks. The four required constant-variable items and the exact dependent-variable specification are not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Does not specify the NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB GPU, fixed random seeds, or the same framework installation and BoT repository configuration. Uses six trials rather than 10 repeated runs per task. Measures wall-clock seconds and proposes an unspecified logarithmic transform rather than explicitly measuring base-10 logarithmic inference time. Adds CoT and additional outcomes beyond the required design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Omits the finding that BoT generally increases inference time relative to single-query methods and all supplied task-specific values, including the exception that BoT is faster than PAL on Game of 24.
